items.question: What qualities must the clay collected by a wise person possess?
premises: A wise person should collect clay.
The clay must be devoid of grass.
The clay must be devoid of stones.
items.inference: Only clay free from grass and stones is suitable for collection by a wise person.
uncertainties: The intended ritual or practical use of the clay is not specified in this fragment.
items.plain_english: A wise person should collect clay that is free from grass and stones.
